records.source: Toast partner ecosystem and restaurant POS implementation market
records.buyer_type: POS implementation partners, restaurant technology MSPs, multi-location restaurant operators
records.example_target_company_or_market: POS implementation partners and restaurant technology providers requiring Arizona field coverage
records.contact_path: Partner operations manager -> deployment manager -> field-service manager
records.pain_solved: Provides local onsite labor for POS swaps, network troubleshooting, printers, KDS, cabling, APs, staging, installation and emergency smart-hands work without the buyer maintaining local technicians.
records.startup_requirements: POS field-service capability sheet, Arizona coverage map, dispatch SLA, photo closeout template, fixed-rate service matrix
records.first_10_target_strategy: Identify 10 POS implementation partners or restaurant technology MSPs that provide nationwide or western-region installation/support but need Arizona field execution.
records.risk_flags: Do not alter payment-processing configurations without authorization; clearly distinguish smart-hands work from merchant-account sales; partner application requires approval.
records.recommended_action: Build a POS Field Coverage capability package and rank the first 10 implementation partners for later approved outreach.
records.status: Research complete - approval required before contact
records.notes: Large installed-base POS ecosystems rely on physical installation, hardware/network engineering, onsite field support and recurring support.

records.source: Storage auction cleanout requirements and buyer deadlines
records.example_target_company_or_market: Online storage auction buyers operating in Phoenix and Maricopa County
records.contact_path: Auction buyer/referral relationship; facility manager relationship where permitted
records.pain_solved: Auction buyers face short cleanout windows and need labor, hauling, disposal coordination and broom-swept closeout quickly.
records.estimated_ticket_value: $250-$1,200 per unit; larger units or multiple-unit routes $1,500+
records.cost_required: $0 upfront when disposal and mileage are incorporated into customer pricing
records.time_to_revenue: Same day-7 days once buyer relationships exist
records.startup_requirements: Photo-based quoting workflow, volume tiers, disposal-cost pass-through, broom-sweep closeout checklist, prohibited-item policy
records.first_10_target_strategy: Map 10 Phoenix-area facilities with frequent online auctions and identify recurring auction buyers/resellers without contacting them yet.
records.risk_flags: Disposal fees, hazardous materials, mattresses/appliances, personal documents, facility access rules and auction-buyer liability must be priced and documented.
records.recommended_action: Productize three cleanout sizes with disposal pass-through and rapid photo quoting.
records.status: Research complete - approval required before contact
records.notes: Deadline-driven cleanout requirements create urgent, repeatable local hauling demand.

records.source: Manheim Phoenix transportation, reconditioning and vehicle movement workflows
records.revenue_play_name: Auction Vehicle Pickup and Dealer Recon Relay
records.buyer_type: Independent dealers, wholesalers, auction buyers, recon shops
records.contact_path: Independent dealer owner -> inventory manager -> recon manager
records.pain_solved: Moves purchased vehicles out of auction inventory quickly and coordinates delivery to dealer, recon, mechanic, glass, tire or detail destinations.
records.cost_required: Fuel and suitable existing transport capacity; towing/transport licensing and insurance requirements must be verified before offering vehicle transport
records.startup_requirements: Transport-scope compliance check, pickup authorization workflow, condition photos, chain-of-custody form, route scheduler
records.first_10_target_strategy: Identify 10 independent Phoenix dealers regularly sourcing auction vehicles and model auction-to-dealer/recon route clusters.
records.risk_flags: Commercial auto/towing regulations, insurance, auction authorization, vehicle damage liability and title/key custody. Do not offer regulated transport until compliance is verified.
records.recommended_action: Start with compliant pickup coordination/recon relay research; separately verify whether existing insurance and equipment permit paid vehicle transport.
records.notes: Time-sensitive vehicle movement creates route-stacking potential around auction and recon workflows.

records.source: Phoenix-area low-voltage retrofit demand and contractor overflow patterns
records.buyer_type: MSPs, electricians, security integrators, property managers, small commercial operators
records.example_target_company_or_market: Phoenix integrators needing small-job or after-hours field capacity
records.contact_path: Service manager -> project manager -> operations manager
records.pain_solved: Handles jobs too small, geographically inconvenient or urgent for larger contractors: Ethernet drops, APs, cameras, troubleshooting, cable remediation and punch lists.
records.cost_required: $0-low for scopes using existing tools and materials billed to buyer
records.startup_requirements: Defined Arizona licensing boundary, service-call rate card, cable-test/photo closeout template, material pass-through policy
records.first_10_target_strategy: Identify 10 MSP/security/electrical integrators that advertise Phoenix coverage and classify likely overflow gaps by geography and service type.
records.risk_flags: Arizona contractor licensing boundaries, permits, fire/life-safety scope and work requiring licensed trades must be excluded or performed through properly licensed partners.
records.recommended_action: Prioritize smart-hands, repair, replacement and subcontract scopes clearly within legal authority.
records.notes: Strong fit for small-job overflow, troubleshooting and documented closeout work.

records.source: AI receptionist referral and reseller channel programs
records.buyer_type: Local service businesses with missed-call revenue loss
records.example_target_company_or_market: Junk removal, mobile mechanics, property services, contractors, clinics and other appointment-driven SMBs
records.pain_solved: Captures calls when staff are busy or unavailable and converts missed calls into appointments or leads.
records.estimated_ticket_value: Recurring referral commission; reseller model can later support $150-$500+ monthly client pricing depending on platform and scope
records.cost_required: $0 using referral tier; paid white-label plans deferred until validated demand
records.stacking_fit: Excellent digital add-on to every service-business relationship
records.startup_requirements: Internal proof-of-work demonstration, disclosure language, call-flow test, ROI calculator and approved partner selection
records.first_10_target_strategy: Use 10 existing or prospective service-business profiles already showing missed-call or scheduling pain; do not contact until approval.
records.risk_flags: TCPA/privacy obligations, call-recording consent, hallucinated commitments, platform dependency and paid reseller plans. No subscription should be purchased before proof of demand.
records.recommended_action: Evaluate a $0 referral model first and build internal proof-of-work before external sale.
records.status: Research complete - no enrollment or spending authorized
records.notes: Recurring channel revenue can become a high-margin add-on after internal proof-of-work is established.
